name: Nabal
overview: The Scripture presents Nabal as a wealthy man of the house of Caleb who possessed extensive flocks and was shearing his sheep in Carmel. Despite his prosperity, Nabal is described as churlish and evil in his actions, contrasting sharply with his wife Abigail, who is noted for her good understanding and beauty. When David, hearing of Nabal's shearing, sent men to greet him and seek peace, Nabal's character is revealed through his response, highlighting a failure to act with kindness and wisdom toward those who had protected his shepherds.
